interfaces.signature: run(request: str, *, thread_id: str | None=None, session_id: str | None=None, trigger: str='chat', responder: str | None=None, run_id: str | None=None) -> dict[str, Any]
interfaces.semantics: Async facade starts or drives a run; thread-level locking and checkpointing support continuation.
interfaces.preconditions: Trigger and identity values are context, not proof of authorization; effect tier controls dispatch.
interfaces.postconditions: Async facade starts or drives a run; thread-level locking and checkpointing support continuation.
interfaces.errorHandling: ThreadBusy and provider failure paths need testing; no timing SLA.
interfaces.variability: Call with synthetic request; inspect pending actions before resume.
interfaces.quality: No independently measured latency, throughput or concurrency SLA
interfaces.rationale: Typed or named boundary supports local inspection; exact caller authentication must be established separately
interfaces.usage: Call with synthetic request; inspect pending actions before resume.

interfaces.signature: resume(thread_id: str, decisions: dict[str, str], note: str='') -> dict[str, Any]
interfaces.semantics: Async facade validates action IDs against pending snapshot, writes decisions and continues only if none remain DRAFTED.
interfaces.preconditions: Unknown action ID raises KeyError; busy thread raises ThreadBusy; no pending snapshot raises LookupError. Persisted audit state is the final effect gate.
interfaces.postconditions: Async facade validates action IDs against pending snapshot, writes decisions and continues only if none remain DRAFTED.
interfaces.errorHandling: Process-local lock does not prove distributed exact-once.
interfaces.variability: Use pending IDs from same thread; test unknown and undecided action.
interfaces.quality: No independently measured latency, throughput or concurrency SLA
interfaces.rationale: Typed or named boundary supports local inspection; exact caller authentication must be established separately
interfaces.usage: Use pending IDs from same thread; test unknown and undecided action.

interfaces.signature: decide(action_id: str, decision: str, note: str='') -> dict[str, Any]
interfaces.semantics: Persists human decision for an action; effect execution is separate.
interfaces.preconditions: Decision is sensitive; caller authentication and argument binding must be verified.
interfaces.postconditions: Persists human decision for an action; effect execution is separate.
interfaces.errorHandling: No exactly-once proof; test repeat, expired and rejected decisions.
interfaces.quality: No independently measured latency, throughput or concurrency SLA
interfaces.rationale: Typed or named boundary supports local inspection; exact caller authentication must be established separately

interfaces.signature: assess(tool_name: str, arguments: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]
interfaces.semantics: Derives risk assessment from proposed tool and arguments.
interfaces.preconditions: Classification is not itself permission to execute.
interfaces.postconditions: Derives risk assessment from proposed tool and arguments.
interfaces.errorHandling: Risk rules and external effects need adversarial tests.
interfaces.variability: Assess before drafting; do not convert risk output into consent.
interfaces.quality: No independently measured latency, throughput or concurrency SLA
interfaces.rationale: Typed or named boundary supports local inspection; exact caller authentication must be established separately
interfaces.usage: Assess before drafting; do not convert risk output into consent.

interfaces.signature: call(name: str, arguments: dict[str, Any] | None=None) -> dict[str, Any]
interfaces.semantics: Async workspace client invokes a configured capability and parses result.
interfaces.preconditions: Capability allowlist, effect tier and provider authorization are separate controls.
interfaces.postconditions: Async workspace client invokes a configured capability and parses result.
interfaces.errorHandling: Provider errors and gateway permissions require independent verification.
interfaces.variability: Use practice workspace read; reject unauthorized names.
interfaces.quality: No independently measured latency, throughput or concurrency SLA
interfaces.rationale: Typed or named boundary supports local inspection; exact caller authentication must be established separately
interfaces.usage: Use practice workspace read; reject unauthorized names.

interfaces.signature: recall(query: str, *, limit: int=8, memory_types: tuple[str, ...] | None=None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]
interfaces.semantics: MemoryProvider retrieves ranked records filtered by memory types where specified.
interfaces.preconditions: Returned text is untrusted evidence, not instruction authority.
interfaces.postconditions: MemoryProvider retrieves ranked records filtered by memory types where specified.
interfaces.errorHandling: Local provider and expiry semantics; retrieval quality unmeasured.
interfaces.variability: Use a fixture query and bounded limit; test expired record.
interfaces.quality: No independently measured latency, throughput or concurrency SLA
interfaces.rationale: Typed or named boundary supports local inspection; exact caller authentication must be established separately
interfaces.usage: Use a fixture query and bounded limit; test expired record.

interfaces.semantics: Removes identified record according to provider contract; returns integer.

interfaces.variability: Test with synthetic record and subsequent recall.
